description: Kinds of notebook (#48). A new notebook picks one in the Import form; it says how its scans become pages and how pages are read. scan: pages per scan and, for spreads, the clockwise turn that makes one upright and where the fold usually is (it's found in each spread). numbering: how page numbers are printed. form: what the pages are written on. Page images are 1600 px tall whatever the paper size.

types.label: Stamped log, spreads
types.describe: A bound notebook scanned open, two pages at a time and sideways, with the rubber-stamped log form (NEW SESSION block and object entries) filled in by hand. Any page size.

types.label: Free-text log, spreads
types.describe: A bound notebook scanned open, two pages at a time and sideways, written in free text with no stamped form (#109): each session starts at a date heading, and each object is a paragraph, with or without a sketch.
